prompt:
Our cross-platform app 'StreamFlow' has design specs submitted by platform teams at submissions/raw/streamflow_design_spec_v3.2.json. The design system team needs a compliance audit before we go to engineering handoff.

Please review the submitted spec and produce a corrected compliance report named streamflow_compliance_report.json. The report should clearly identify every design problem across all platforms (iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS) and specify the correct values or requirements. We want to make sure every platform follows proper native design standards — things like correct fonts, spacing, navigation placement, touch targets, color contrast, and animation timing. There are quite a few issues in there that the platform teams got wrong.

The compliance report should cover all five platforms and be detailed enough that engineers can use it to fix the spec.
